claim_review: Current model source pack and owner-confirmed numeric EU labels; visible construction only. No measured width grade, tested performance, fiber inference, guaranteed stock, free sample or fixed lead-time claims. Commercial answers use the approved original-style MOQ separately from custom proposals. Existing photos/SKUs and all unsubmitted fields preserved.
highlights:
Plush-lined winter ankle boots with laces, upper hook eyelets and a side zipper. The zipper provides an additional opening for putting the boot on, while the laces adjust the upper. A contrast ankle strap and pull tab give the style a distinctive seasonal boot profile.
Black, Yellow, Khaki; EU 39-48 provide color and size choices for wholesale assortments.
Original-style wholesale orders start from 2 pairs, allowing buyers to request a small trial assortment.

faq.question: What are the available colors and sizes?
faq.answers: Black, Yellow, Khaki; EU 39-48. List the pair quantity for each color and EU size to request your assortment.

faq.question: Does this boot have both laces and a zipper?
faq.answers: Yes. It has conventional laces with upper hook eyelets, plus a side zipper. A contrast ankle strap and pull tab complete the ankle-height design.

faq.question: How should I choose a size?
faq.answers: Use EU sizes and compare your foot length with the size information for this style. For a trial fitting, choose your usual EU size and assess a sample with the socks you plan to wear.

faq.question: What is the minimum order for the original style?
faq.answers: The original-style wholesale minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page. Logo, material or custom packaging requests are quoted separately from the original-style order.

faq.question: How can I arrange a sample?
faq.answers: Request a sample quotation with your preferred color, EU size and delivery postcode. The quotation will include the sample charge, shipping cost and proposed dispatch schedule.

faq.question: What should I send for a branding or packaging quotation?
faq.answers: Send your logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. We can review the brief for this style and provide a proposal with the applicable minimum, cost and sample process.

faq.question: How can I get a delivered quotation and shipment schedule?
faq.answers: Send the color-size quantities and destination postcode or port, plus any packaging request. The quotation separates product cost from freight and sets out the dispatch plan and estimated transit time for your chosen shipping method.
